label: Bible Study
prompt: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my _____ out of Egypt.
verse: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
note: Matthew sees this fulfilled when the young Jesus returns from Egypt with Mary and Joseph.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you _____: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verse: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
note: Peace in the land, and you lie down with none to make you afraid — the blessing every tired parent wants.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the _____, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
verse: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
note: King Jehoiakim sliced up Jeremiah's scroll with a penknife and fed it to the fire — so Jeremiah dictated it again.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How _____ are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verse: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
note: Paul quotes Isaiah 52:7 — even dusty feet look lovely when they're carrying good news.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye _____ up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
verse: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
note: Two men in white at the Ascension, gently: why stand ye 'gazing'? He'll come back the same way he left.
